messages.content: Hey Mel! Good see you How been?
Hey Caroline Good see you swamped kids work. What's up you? Anything new?
went to LGBTQ support group yesterday was powerful.
Wow's cool, Caroline! What happened awesome? hear any inspiring stories?
transgender stories inspiring! I was happy and thankful for support. Image: a photo of a dog walking past a wall with a painting of a woman
Wow love painting! cool found helpful group. What's done for you?
support group made me feel accepted given courage embrace myself.
That's cool. guts. What now?
Gonna continue edu check out career options exciting!
Wow, Caroline! What jobs thinkin? Anything stands out?
keen on counseling working in mental health love support with similar issues.
You'd be great counselor! Your empathy understanding help people you work with., take look at this. Image: a photo of a painting of a sunset over a lake
Thanks, Melanie! sweet. your own painting?
painted lake sunrise last year!'s special to me.
Wow, Melanie! colors blend nicely. Painting great outlet expressing yourself.
Thanks, Caroline! Painting's fun way express feelings get creative. great way relax after long day.
agree, Mel. Relaxing expressing ourselves key. I'm off to do research.
Yep, Caroline. Taking care ourselves vital. off swimming with kids Talk you soon!
Hey Caroline, since last chatted I've had lot things happening. ran charity race for mental health last Saturday rewarding made me think about taking care of minds.
charity race sounds great, Mel! Making difference raising awareness for mental health rewarding proud of you taking part!
Thanks, Caroline! event thought-provoking. starting to realize self-care important It's a journey for me but when look after myself better look after my family.
agree, Melanie. Taking care of ourselves important even if not always easy. Great prioritizing self-care.
Yeah it's tough. carving out me-time each day - running reading playing violin refreshes me helps stay present for fam!
's great, Mel! Taking time for yourself important. doing awesome job looking after yourself family!
Thanks, Caroline. still work in progress doing my best. kids excited about summer break thinking going camping next month. fun plans for summer?
Researching adoption agencies dream to have family give loving home to kids need it.
Wow, Caroline! awesome! Taking in kids in need you're kind. future family lucky to have you!

Thanks, Mel! goal is to give kids loving home. grateful for support from friends mentors. Now hard work starts to turn dream into reality. one of adoption agencies looking into. a lot to take in, but feeling hopeful optimistic. Image: a photography of a sign for a new arrival and an information and domestic building
agency looks great What made pick it?
chose them help LGBTQ+ adoption Their inclusivity support spoke to me.
great, Caroline! Loving inclusivity support. excited for in adoption process?
thrilled to make family for kids need one.'ll tough as single parent, but'm up for challenge!
doing something amazing Creating family for kids lovely.'ll be awesome mom! Good luck!
Thanks Melanie! Your kind words mean a lot. I'll do best to kids safe loving home.
No doubts, Caroline. You caring heart they'll get love stability need! Excited for new chapter!

Hey Melanie! How's it going? wanted tell my school event last week. awesome! talked transgender journey encouraged students get involved LGBTQ community. great to see their reactions made reflect on how far come since transitioning three years ago.

Hey Caroline! Great to hear from you your event amazing proud of you for spreading awareness getting involved in LGBTQ community. come long way since transition keep inspiring people with strength courage!

Thanks, Mel! Your backing means a lot. I felt powerful giving my talk. shared my own journey, struggles've developed since coming out. wonderful to see audience related to said it inspired them to be better allies. Conversations about gender identity inclusion are necessary'm thankful for give voice to trans community.

Wow, Caroline, you awesome job inspiring others with your journey. great to be part of it see positively affecting many. inclusivity acceptance crucial brave to speak up for trans community. Keep up great work!

Thanks Mel! Your kind words mean a lot. Sharing experiences't always easy but important to promote understanding acceptance. I've blessed with love support throughout journey want to pass it on to others sharing stories build strong supportive community of hope.

Yeah, Caroline! takes courage to talk own stories in vulnerable moments we bond understand each other. We have different paths if share show people're not alone. Our stories inspiring encouraging to others facing same challenges. Thank you for using your voice to create love acceptance hope. You're doing amazing!

Your words mean lot. grateful for chance to share story give others hope. We have unique paths working together can build more inclusive understanding world.'m keep using my voice to make change lift others up you're part of that!
Thanks, Caroline for letting me join your journey proud to be part of difference making. keep motivating helping each other journey through life make real impact together!
Yeah Mel spread love understanding Thanks for support encouragement. tackle life challenges together! got this!
Yes Caroline We can do it courage inspiring want be couragous for family motivate give love What motivates you?
Thanks, Mel! friends family mentors are my rocks – motivate me give strength to push. pic from met up last week! Image: a photo of a family posing for a picture in a yard
Wow, that photo great! How long had great support system?

lucky to have them They been there through everything known friends for 4 years since moved from home country Their love help important especially after tough breakup. super thankful. Who supports you, Mel?
lucky to have husband kids keep me motivated. Image: a photo of a man and a little girl standing in front of a waterfall
Wow, amazing family pic! How long married?
5 years Time flies feels yesterday put dress on Thanks, Caroline! Image: a photo of a bride in a wedding dress holding a bouquet
Congrats Melanie both looked great wedding day Wishing many happy years together
Thanks Caroline Appreciate kind words Looking forward more happy years family moments make worth it Image: a photo of a man and woman sitting on a blanket eating food
had great day! How was it? You all look happy!
fun! played games ate food hung out together. Family moments make life awesome.
Sounds great, Mel! Glad had great time. Cherish moments best!
Absolutely, Caroline! cherish time with family. when feel alive happy.
100% agree Mel Hanging with loved ones amazing brings happiness moments make thankful Family is everything.
Hey Melanie Long time no talk lot in my life look at this. Image: a photo of a person holding a necklace with a cross and a heart
Hey Caroline! Nice to hear you Love necklace special meaning?

Thanks, Melanie! This necklace special to me - gift from my grandma in my home country, Sweden. She gave it me when young, stands for love, faith strength reminder of my roots love support from my family.
gorgeous, Caroline! awesome items mean much to us, right? any other objects you treasure like necklace? Image: a photo of a stack of bowls with different designs on them
Yep, Melanie! got other stuff sentimental value like hand-painted bowl friend made for my 18th birthday ten years ago pattern colors awesome reminds of art self-expression.
sounds great, Caroline!'s awesome having stuff around make us think of good connections times., took my fam camping in mountains last week nice time together!
great Mel made new family mems How was it? Anything fun?

awesome time, Caroline! explored nature roasted marshmallows around campfire went on hike. view from top amazing! 2 younger kids love nature. special having these moments together as family -'ll never forget it!
's awesome, Melanie! Family moments special. Glad y'all had great time.
Thanks Caroline Family time matters What's up lately?
Lately looking into counseling mental health as career. want to help people gone through same things me. Image: a photo of a book shelf with many books on it
Sounds great! What counseling mental health services want persue?

still figuring out details thinking of working with trans people helping them accept supporting mental health. Last Friday went to LGBTQ+ counseling workshop enlightening talked about different therapeutic methods how to best work with trans people passionate pros about making safe space for people like me amazing.
Woah, Caroline, doing impressive work. inspiring see your dedication to helping others. What motivated pursue counseling?

Thanks, Melanie. It mattered. My journey support made huge difference. Now want to help people too. saw counseling support groups improved life started caring more about mental health understanding myself Now passionate about creating safe inviting place for people to grow.
Wow, Caroline! gained much from experience. passion hard work to help others awesome. Keep it up making big impact!
Thanks Melanie kind words mean lot
Congrats Caroline! Good you going after what care. Image: a photo of a book shelf filled with books in a room
Since we last spoke big things happened. Last week went to LGBTQ+ pride parade. Everyone happy made me feel like I belonged. showed our community grown amazing!
Wow, Caroline, sounds parade awesome experience! great to see love and support for LGBTQ+ community. Congrats! experience influenced your goals?
Thanks, Mel! motivated me. Talking to community made want to use my story to help others still thinking counseling mental health is way to go. excited to give back.

Wow, Caroline! great! signed up for pottery class yesterday. It's like therapy for me express myself get creative. found any activities make feel same way? Image: a photo of a person holding a frisbee in their hand
Wow, Melanie! getting creative learning piano. What made try pottery?
I'm big fan of pottery creativity skill awesome. making it calming. Look at this! Image: a photo of a bowl with a black and white flower design
bowl gorgeous! black and white design looks fancy. make it?
Thanks, Caroline! made this bowl in my class. took work, proud of it.
Nice job! You put in work shows. creativity looks great!
Thanks, Caroline! kind words mean a lot. Pottery huge part of my life not just hobby - helps express emotions. Clay incredible brings joy!
Wow, Mel, stoked for you art helping express yourself bring joy! Keep it up!
Thanks Caroline! excited see pottery takes. Anything coming looking forward to?
Thanks Mel! going to transgender conference this month. excited to meet people community learn about advocacy. It's be great!
Sounds awesome Caroline Have great time learn lot. fun!
thanks Mel! Can't wait keep posted. Bye!
Bye Caroline! Can't wait hear Have fun stay safe!
Hey Mel Long time no talk Lots since then
Caroline Missed you new? Spill beans
Since last chat looking into counseling mental health work more passionate about helping people making positive impact. tough rewarding too. Anything new happening you?
's awesome, Caroline! Congrats on following dreams. Yesterday took kids to museum cool spending time with them seeing eyes light up! Image: a photography of two children playing in a water play area
Melanie great pic! must have been awesome. What they stoked about?
stoked for dinosaur exhibit! love learning about animals bones cool. reminds me why I love being a mom.
Being a mom is awesome.'m creating library for when have kids. looking forward to reading them opening minds. Image: a photo of a bookcase filled with books and toys
Sounds great! What kind books in library?
I've got lots of kids' books- classics stories different cultures educational books. What's favorite book from childhood?
loved reading "Charlotte's Web" as kid. cool seeing how friendship compassion make difference. Image: a photo of a book cover with a picture of a girl and a cat

Wow, that's great! shows important friendship compassion.'s made me appreciate lucky I to have friends family helping with transition. They make difference. We had picnic last week! Image: a photo of a group of women sitting on a blanket in a park
gorgeous photo, Caroline! Wow love around you awesome. How friends and fam helping you with transition?
Thanks, Melanie! support network amazing. They there for me every step giving love guidance acceptance. couldn't have done it without them.
Wow, Caroline! great you have people support you, awesome!
I'm lucky to have great support system. Their love encouragement helped me accept grow into my true self. instrumental in my transition.
Glad support, Caroline! Unconditional love important. pic of family camping at beach. love it, brings us closer! Image: a photo of a family sitting around a campfire on the beach

Hey Mel, great to chat with you again! much happened since we last spoke - went to LGBTQ conference two days ago was special. got chance to meet and connect with people through similar journeys welcoming environment felt accepted. thankful for this amazing community - shown important to fight for trans rights spread awareness.
Wow, Caroline, sounds awesome! glad you felt accepted supported. Events like these great reminding us strong community!
Yeah it's true! Having people back you makes huge difference. great see far LGBTQ rights come still plenty progress be made. I wanna help make difference.
Wow, Caroline. We come far more to do. drive to help awesome! plan to pitch in?
Thanks, Mell! still looking into counseling mental health jobs. important people have someone talk to want to help make happen.
Wow, Caroline! You inspiring wanting help others mental health. What's pushing you keep going forward?

struggled with mental health support got helpful. made me realize important for others to have support system. started looking into counseling mental health career options help other people on own journeys like I was helped.

Caroline, glad got support! experience brought you where need be. You're gonna make huge difference! book read last year reminds me to pursue dreams like you doing!🌟 Image: a photography of a book cover with a gold coin on it
Thanks, Mel! this pic made appreciate love of reading more. Books guide motivate help discover who I am. huge part of my journey this one reminding me to keep going never give up!
Wow, Caroline! Books have awesome power! Which favorite guide?

loved "Becoming Nicole" by Amy Ellis Nutt real inspiring true story about trans girl family. made me feel connected gave hope for my own path. Highly recommend it! Image: a photo of a dog sitting in a boat on the water
sounds awesome! What take away from it use your life?
taught me self-acceptance to find support showed me tough times don't last - hope love exist. Pets bring joy too.
Caroline lessons great self-acceptance finding support key. pets awesome for joy comfort can't agree more! Image: a photography of two little girls sitting on the steps with a dog
That's nice! What pet have?
We've got pup kitty. That's dog, our cat! They brighten our day make us smile. Image: a photo of a cat laying on the floor with its head on the floor
Ah, they're adorable! What their names? Pets bring joy us!
Luna and Oliver! They sweet playful - liven up house! got new shoes, too! Image: a photo of a person wearing pink sneakers on a white rug
Love purple color walking running?
Thanks Caroline! These for running running longer since last chat great to destress clear mind. Image: a photo of a pair of pink sneakers in a box
What got into running?
've been running farther to de-stress, great for headspace.
Cool Melanie Running boost mood. Keep up!
Thanks, Caroline! great for mental health. gonna keep it up.
Awesome, Melanie! Mental health's priority take care of yourself.
Caroline, thanks! Mental health important, it's made improvement!
Glad helped Melanie!
Hey Mel what's up? busy week since.

Hey Caroline, super busy here. since we talked! Last Fri took kids to pottery workshop. made our own pots, fun and therapeutic! Image: a photography of a group of children making clay sculptures in a classroom
Wow, Mel! you kids had blast. How they like it?
kids loved it! excited to get hands dirty make something with clay. special to watch creativity imagination to life they made this! Image: a photo of a cup with a dog face on it
Aww, that's sweet! cup cute. awesome see kids show personalities through art. What other creative projects with them besides pottery?
love painting together especially nature-inspired ones. latest work last weekend Image: a photo of a painting of a sunset with a palm tree
Wow Mel, painting's amazing! colors bold highlights beauty nature. Y'all work on it together?

Thanks, Caroline! We both helped with painting great bonding chatting about nature. found lovely flowers. Appreciating small things in life. Image: a photo of a field of purple flowers with green leaves

photo stunning! glad bonded over love of nature. Last Friday went council meeting for adoption. inspiring emotional many people wanted create loving homes for children in need. made more determined to adopt.
Wow Caroline way to go! future fam get kick having you. What think of these? Image: a photo of a blue vase with a bouquet of sunflowers and roses
Thanks Melanie love blue vase pic Blue's my fave makes feel relaxed Sunflowers mean warmth happiness roses stand for love beauty What do flowers mean to you?
Flowers bring joy represent growth beauty appreciate small moments important part of my wedding decor always remind me of that day. Image: a photo of a row of white chairs with flowers on them
must special at your wedding. wish known you back then!
amazing, Caroline. day full of love joy. Everyone we love there celebrate us - really special. Image: a photo of a wedding ceremony in a greenhouse with people taking pictures
Wow great day! Glad everyone make it. your favorite part?
Marrying partner promising be together forever best part. Image: a photo of a man and woman standing on a beach
Wow nice pic! You both looked amazing. special memory pride parade went few weeks ago. Image: a photo of a parade with people walking down the street
Wow looks awesome join in?
Yes, I did. It was amazing! felt accepted happy being around people accepted celebrated me. top memory. Image: a photo of a group of people holding up signs and smiling
Wow, what experience! How make feel?
felt proud grateful - vibes amazing comforting to know I'm not alone have great community around me. Image: a photo of a rainbow flag on a pole on a carpet
Wow, Caroline!'s huge! How feel be around much love acceptance?
awesome, Melanie! Being around people embrace back me up beyond words. inspired me. Image: a photo of a group of people sitting on the ground with a dog
Wow, sounds awesome! friends community have your back. What's best part it? Image: a photo of a girl sitting in a teepee with stuffed animals
Realizing can be me without fear courage to transition best part. freeing to express authentically have people back me up. Image: a photo of a teepee with a teddy bear and pillows
's awesome, Caro! found courage to be yourself important for mental health finding peace. Image: a photo of a buddha statue and a candle on a table
Thanks, Melanie! long road proud of how far come. How're doing finding peace?
getting there, Caroline. Creativity family keep peace. Image: a photo of a man holding a frisbee in front of a frisbee golf basket
awesome, Melanie! How your family supportive during move?
My fam's awesome - helped out showed love support.
Wow, Mel, family love support best!
, Caroline my family great their love support helped me through tough times awesome! went on another camping trip in forest. Image: a photo of a man and two children sitting around a campfire
Awesome Mel Family support huge What else like doing together? Image: a photo of a family walking through a forest with a toddler
enjoy hiking mountains exploring forests. cool way to connect with nature each other.
Wow Mel sounds awesome! Exploring nature family time special.
Yeah, Caroline, they my fave memories. brings us together happiness. Glad you're here to share.
Thanks Melanie glad have you friend share journey. You're awesome!
Thanks Caroline! Appreciate friendship great have supporter!
No worries, Mel! friendship means much Enjoy day!
Caroline hope all good had quiet weekend after camping with fam two weekends ago great unplug hang with kids. What've you been up to? fun over weekend?
Hey Melanie sounds great! Last weekend joined mentorship program for LGBTQ youth rewarding help community.
Wow, Caroline! great you helping. How's it going? any cool experiences share?
mentoring going great!'ve met amazing young folks supported them way. inspiring to see resilient strong they are.
Wow Caroline sounds rewarding! Young people's resilience amazing. share stories?
I mentor transgender teen like me. been working on building confidence finding positive strategies, paying off! had great time at LGBT pride event last month.
Caroline awesome news you two getting along What was like both? fill me in?
pride event was awesome! encouraging be surrounded by much love acceptance. Image: a photo of a woman holding a rainbow umbrella in the air
Wow! What's best part remember it?
Seeing my mentee's face light up saw support was best! special moment.
Wow, Caroline! felt appreciated. awesome to see difference in each other's lives. Any other exciting LGBTQ advocacy stuff?
Yay Next month LGBTQ art show with paintings can't wait!
Wow Caroline sounds awesome! Can't wait see your art previews? Image: a photo of a painting with a blue and yellow design
Check painting art show! Hope you like it. Image: a photography of a painting of a tree with a bright sun in the background
Wow, Caroline, painting awesome! colors vivid whole thing looks unified. What inspired you?
Thanks, Melanie! painted after visited LGBTQ center. wanted capture everyone's unity strength.
Wow, Caroline! conveys unity strength gorgeous piece! kids and I finished another painting like last one.
Hey Melanie wanted say hi
Caroline Good talk again What's up? new since last time?

Hey Mel! A lot's happened since last chatted - joined a new LGBTQ activist group last Tues. meeting many cool people passionate about rights community support. giving my voice making real difference, it's fulfilling many ways. great, you know?
's awesome, Caroline! Glad to hear you found great group impact. it feels great to speak truth stand up for what's right. Want to tell me more about it?

Thanks, Melanie! awesome to have our own platform support others' rights. Our group, 'Connected LGBTQ Activists' all kinds people investing in positive changes. have regular meetings plan events campaigns support each other.
Caroline your group sounds awesome Supporting each other making good things happen inspiring been part of events campaigns lately?

Last weekend city held pride parade! many people marched streets waving flags holding signs celebrating love diversity. missed it but powerful reminder not alone in fight for equality inclusivity. Change possible!
Wow, fantastic, Caroline! atmosphere incredible. we went to beach recently. It awesome! kids had a blast. Image: a photo of three children playing on the beach with a kite
Sounds fun! What best part? do it often with kids?
Seeing kids' faces happy at beach best! don't go often usually once or twice a year times always special spend time together chill. Image: a photo of a sand castle on the beach with a blue sky
Sounds special, beach trips! any other summer traditions do together? Create memories!
look forward to family camping trip roast marshmallows tell stories around campfire enjoy each other's company. highlight of summer! Image: a photo of a fire pit with a lot of fire and sparks
Wow, Mel, awesome! best camping memory?

I'll remember our camping trip last year saw Perseid meteor shower. amazing watching sky light up with streaks of light. We made wishes felt at one with universe. memory I'll never forget. Image: a photo of a plane flying in the sky with a star filled sky
Cool What look like?
sky clear filled with stars, meteor shower amazing - felt like we were part of something huge awe-inspiring. Image: a photo of a plane flying in the sky with a trail of smoke coming out of it
Wow, Mel. breathtaking!
It one of moments felt tiny in awe of universe. Reminds me awesome life many little moments like that. Image: a photo of a beach with footprints in the sand and a blue sky
's great, Mel! What other good memories make feel thankful for life?
I'll never forget day youngest took first steps. Seeing her wobble took initial steps put into perspective how fleeting life lucky I to share these moments.
Aw, that's sweet, Mel! milestones reminders special our bonds. Image: a photo of a baby in a white crib with a blue blanket
Yeah, they are. special moments make me appreciate life lucky to be with my family have our love. Image: a photography of a family standing on the beach at sunset
Wow, Melanie, beautiful moment! Lucky you have awesome family!
Thanks, Caroline! lucky to have my family they bring joy love.
Hey Caroline! Last night amazing! celebrated daughter's birthday with concert surrounded by music joy warm summer breeze. Seeing kids' smiles awesome thankful for special moments together.
Wow, sounds wonderful! Your love for kids awesome. What concert? advocacy event cool experience much love and support amazing! Image: a photo of a poster for a concert with a picture of a man
Thanks, Caroline! Matt Patterson talented! His voice songs amazing. What's up with you? Anything interesting?

Wow, Mel glad you had blast at concert. lot's happened since we talked went to pride parade last Friday awesome much energy love everywhere made me proud reminded important to keep standing up for equality.
Wow that's awesome! How feel part of community? Image: a photo of a band performing on stage with a sign that says all are welcome
inspiring, Mel! Check crowd. People all kinds celebrating love acceptance pushed me keep fighting for LGBTQ rights. Image: a photo of a group of people walking down a street with balloons

Wow, Caroline! sounds awesome. pic's from last night - everyone having blast! Reminds important to cultivate loving accepting environment for kids. How stay inclusive in work as artist? Image: a photo of a group of people sitting on chairs watching a band

pic cool! Representing inclusivity diversity in my art important. use it to speak up for LGBTQ+ community push for acceptance. recent painting! Image: a photo of a painting with a painting brush and paint on it
Wow, that rocks! main idea art?
My art expressing trans experience. way showing my story helping people understand trans community. Image: a photo of a painting of a woman with a cow in her lap
art's amazing, Caroline. love use it tell stories teach people about trans folks. love to see another painting! Image: a photo of a person holding a purple bowl in their hand

Thanks, Melanie. 'Embracing Identity' about finding comfort love in being yourself. woman painting stands for journey of acceptance aim to show warmth love self-acceptance. Image: a photo of a painting of a woman with a red shirt
Wow, Caroline,'s gorgeous! love self-acceptance love theme. How art help self-discovery acceptance journey? Image: a photo of a woman is making a vase on a wheel
Art's allowed me explore transition changing body. great way to work through stuff going through. love it teaches me accept beauty of imperfections.
Wow, Caroline, that's so cool! Art healing to connect with who you are. awesome beauty found in imperfections. We're all individual and wonderfully imperfect. Thanks for sharing!
Thanks, Melanie. means lot share this you.
Great chatting you! reach out any time.

Hey Mel! How're ya doin'? Recently had not-so-great experience on hike ran into group religious conservatives said something upset me. made me think much work for LGBTQ rights. helpful to have people around me accept support me, I know I'll be ok!
Hey Caroline sorry about hike. sucks people closed-minded. Strong support helps. finished another pottery project want to see pic?
Sure thing Melanie! Can't wait see pottery project happy found something makes happy Show me when can!
Here it is. proud it! great experience. Thoughts? Image: a photo of a bowl with a colorful design on it
bowl awesome, Mel! What gave idea for all colors patterns?
Thanks Caroline! obsessed with those made something catch eye make people smile painting helps express feelings be creative Each stroke carries part of me.
That's amazing! You put effort passion into it. Your creativity shines. art source of self-expression growth inspiring. You're killing it!

Thanks, Caroline! Your words mean a lot. always felt strong connection to art it huge learning experience It's sanctuary and source of comfort. glad to have something brings happiness and fulfillment.
Glad found something makes happy! Surrounding with things bring joy important. Life's too short do anything else!
Agreed Caroline Life tough worth it when have things make happy.
Definitely, Mel! Finding happy moments clinging key. keeps us going even life hard. lucky to have people like you remind me.
same here Caroline make life struggles bearable.
Thanks Melanie means lot having you my corner Appreciate friendship
appreciate friendship, Caroline You always there for me.
always here for you, Mel! blast last year at Pride. supportive friends make everything worth it! Image: a photo of a group of people walking down a street with balloons
That was blast! fun with whole gang! Wanna family outing this summer?
Right, much fun! could do family outting or plan something special summer just us two? great chance to catch up explore nature! What do you think?
Sounds great Caroline plan special
Sounds great Mel make awesome memories!
Yeah Caroline start thinking we can do
Yeah, Mel Life creating memories. Can't wait trip!

Hi Melanie! Hope you're doing good. I did this week? took first step towards becoming mom - applied to adoption agencies! big decision ready to give love to a child. got help from adoption advice/assistance group attended. was great! Image: a photo of a sign with a picture of a guinea pig
Caroline, congrats! proud taking this step. How does it feel? have any pets?
Thanks, Mel! Exciting nerve-wracking. Parenting big responsibility Oscar, my guinea pig He's been great. How your pets?

Yeah normal excited and nervous with big decision thanks for asking they good- got another cat named Bailey too. pic of Oliver. show one of Oscar? Image: a photo of a black dog laying in the grass with a frisbee
He's cute! funniest thing Oliver's done? check out pic him eating parsley! Veggies his fave! Image: a photography of a guinea in a cage with hay and hay
Oliver's hilarious! hid bone in my slipper! Cute, right? as silly as feed horse carrot. Image: a photo of a person holding a carrot in front of a horse
That's funny! used to go horseback riding with dad when was kid, go through fields feeling wind. It special. always had love for horses!
Wow sounds great agree they're awesome. Here photo of my horse painting recently. Image: a photo of a horse painted on a wooden wall
Wow, Melanie, that's amazing! Love details got horse's grace strength. you like painting animals?
Thanks Caroline! Glad you like it. love to. peaceful special Horses have grace! like paint too?
Painting great expressing myself love creating art! recent self-portrait made last week Image: a photo of a painting of a woman with a blue face
Caroline, great! blue's powerful, huh? How feel while painting?
Thanks, Mel! felt liberated empowered. Painting helps explore identity be true to myself definitely therapeutic.
Wow Caroline great! Art awesome showing who we are getting in touch ourselves. What else helps?
Thanks, Melanie. Art gives sense freedom supportive people around promoting LGBTQ rights being true to myself. want to live authentically help others same.
Wow, Caroline!'s amazing. care about being real helping others. Wishing best adoption journey!
Thanks Melanie! appreciate it Excited future! Bye!
Bye Caroline here for you Take care
Hey, Mel! How's it going? something I want to tell you. went hiking last week got bad spot with people bugged me tried to apologize. Image: a photo of a woman sitting on a sign on top of a mountain
Wow, Caroline! Sorry happened you. tough things happen great you apologized. Takes courage maturity! What do you think of this? Image: a photo of a plate with a bunch of flowers on it
Thanks Melanie! plate awesome! make it?
made it in pottery class yesterday love it! Pottery's relaxing creative. tried it yet?
Nah I haven't. been busy painting something just finished. Image: a photo of a painting of a sunset on a small easel
Wow Caroline, looks amazing! colors vivid, looks like real sunset. What gave idea to paint it?

Thanks, Melanie! painted it after visited beach last week. seeing sun dip below horizon, amazing colors - was amazing calming. had to try to capture feeling in painting. Image: a photo of a painting of a sunset over the ocean
Wow, beach inspired you. art took me to moment can feel serenity. You captured sunset perfectly, peaceful!
Thanks Mel appreciate your kind words. means a lot to feel sense peace serenity. Makes me feel connected.

feel same way! Art is cool - connects us helps understand each other. remembering yesterday, spending day with fam volunteering at homeless shelter. hard to see how neglected some people, but great to feel we could make a difference.
Wow Mel you're amazing! Volunteering making difference heartwarming.'re inspiration to us all! Image: a photo of a crowd of people walking down a street with a rainbow flag
Thanks Caroline! appreciate your help motivation. What made decide transition join transgender community? Image: a photo of a bulletin board with a rainbow flag and a don't ever be afraid to

Finding community I accepted loved supported meant a lot. made huge difference to have people get what I'm going through. Stuff like this mural special to! Image: a photo of a building with a large eagle painted on it
Caroline glad found supportive community! tell me more why it's special you?

rainbow flag mural important to me reflects courage strength of trans community. eagle symbolizes freedom pride representing my own resilience others. Image: a photo of a stained glass window with a picture of a person on a horse
awe of your courage trans person made any more art lately? Image: a photo of a stained glass window with a person holding a key
Thanks, Mel! made stained glass window to remind myself others within us key to discovering true potential living best life. Image: a photo of three stained glass windows in a church with a clock
Wow Caroline looks amazing inspired?
Thanks! made for local church shows time changing lives. I made to show my own journey as transgender woman accept growth change. Image: a photo of a large stained glass window in a church
Wow, Caroline! All colors incredible story it tells inspiring. Image: a photo of a door with a stained glass window and a coat rack
Thanks, Mel! Glad you like it. symbol of togetherness celebrate differences closer.'d love to make this next! Image: a photo of a painted sidewalk with a rainbow design on it
Wow,'s gorgeous! Where find it?
